description: Answers about U.S. public companies grounded in primary SEC filings, with every figure linked back to its source on SEC EDGAR. Pull exact as-filed XBRL facts and multi-period financial statements, track a metric across fiscal periods, screen and rank 5,500+ companies by financials, compare peers, read filing sections (risk factors, MD&A, earnings), and full-text search SEC EDGAR. Coverage: 10-K/10-Q (and amendments), 8-K, 20-F/40-F/6-K (foreign issuers that file with the SEC), and DEF 14A proxy statements. Not covered: insider/ownership filings (Forms 3/4/5, 13D/G), institutional holdings (13F), or registration/offering prospectuses (S-1, 424B). Updated daily from SEC EDGAR; daily end-of-day prices from a market-data feed. Informational research tool, not investment advice. Free up to 500 queries/day.
